test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Indian Desert is correct?

options.text: The Indian Desert lies to the east of the Aravali Hills and receives moderate rainfall.
It is a rocky plateau covered with dense forests and seasonal rivers.
The Indian Desert is an undulating sandy plain with sand dunes and receives less than 150 mm of rainfall annually.
The region lies in the southern part of the Deccan Plateau and is rich in black soil.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Indian Desert is an undulating sandy plain with sand dunes and receives less than 150 mm of rainfall annually.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Desert, also known as the Thar Desert, is located in the northwestern part of India, primarily covering Rajasthan.
 
• It is characterized by an undulating sandy plain, interspersed with sand dunes formed by wind erosion and deposition.
 
• The region receives extremely low rainfall, averaging less than 150 mm annually, making it one of the driest areas in India.
 
• Vegetation in the desert is sparse, comprising mostly xerophytic plants adapted to arid conditions.
 
• The climate is harsh, with temperatures ranging from extreme heat during the day to cold nights, and the region experiences frequent dust storms due to its arid nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: The Indian Desert lies to the east of the Aravali Hills and receives moderate rainfall**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect because the Indian Desert lies to the west of the Aravali Hills, not the east.
 
• The desert region does not receive moderate rainfall; instead, it receives extremely scanty rainfall, as noted in the correct answer.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: It is a rocky plateau covered with dense forests and seasonal rivers**
 
 
• This description is inaccurate for the Indian Desert, which is not a rocky plateau but a sandy terrain characterized by sand dunes.
 
• The desert lacks dense forests and seasonal rivers due to its arid climate and minimal rainfall.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The region lies in the southern part of the Deccan Plateau and is rich in black soil**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect as the Indian Desert is located in the northwestern part of India, not in the southern part of the Deccan Plateau.
 
• The desert is characterized by sandy soil, not black soil, which is typically found in regions with volcanic activity, such as the Deccan Plateau.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme: The Indian Desert (Thar Desert)**
 
 
• The Thar Desert covers approximately 200,000 square kilometers, making it the 17th largest desert globally.
 
• It extends into parts of Pakistan, where it is known as the Cholistan Desert.
 
• Despite its harsh conditions, the desert is home to several communities and features unique biodiversity, including species adapted to arid environments.
